Subject: Deployment mode & pricing — recap and next steps

Hi Ava / Ben — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps. Please reply with any corrections.

Summary of needs (from our call):
- Workload: conversational assistant + async summarization for clinical docs; mix of short (10–50 tokens) and long (up to ~4k tokens) requests.
- SLA: soft 95th p95 latency target ~500ms for interactive flows.
- Throughput: baseline ~50 qps peak for interactive flows, spikes to ~120 qps for batch jobs.
- Data controls: PHI in some flows; need VPC or dedicated controls & KMS/HSM integration.
- Compliance: SOC 2 required; likely need audit logs and retention controls.

Initial deployment recommendation (qual):
- Hosted API: fastest to ship and good for early validation; per-token economics are favorable for low sustained volume but less predictable with heavy tail spikes.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): recommended if you want predictable throughput and unit economics at scale (monthly committed GPUs). Also supports stronger network isolation and throughput guarantees.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): appropriate if regulations require customer-managed networking or strict PHI controls; will add onboarding + infra costs.

Cost/Price oriented next steps I’ll follow up with:
1) Ballpark cost models (two scenarios): 50M tokens/month and 500M tokens/month — compare Hosted per-token vs Dedicated reserved commit (monthly).
2) Call out incremental costs: network egress, KMS requests, and storage for logs/retention.
3) Provide a draft mutual action plan and timeline for a POC (Hosted -> Dedicated migration).

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-pricing-sheet-v1.pdf (pricing ranges), demo-recording-030726.mp4 (recording of today’s demo)

Hi Ava / Ben — thanks for the questions. Below are ballpark numbers and assumptions for quick budget planning. These are modeled estimates — we’ll produce a formal Dedicated quote and SOW once you confirm the preferred path.

Assumptions:
- Model family: mid-sized open model (costs scaled accordingly). If you use a larger proprietary model, numbers change.
- Token split: 1:1 prompt:generated tokens on average.
- Network egress and KMS: modeled separately below.

Hosted API (metered per token) — ballparks:
- Input tokens: $0.02 per 1k tokens => $20 per 1M input tokens
- Output tokens: $0.05 per 1k tokens => $50 per 1M output tokens
- Combined (1M total tokens counted both ways as used): ~ $70 per 1M tokens

Examples:
- Scenario A (50M tokens/month): 50 x $70 = $3,500 / month (Hosted)
- Scenario B (500M tokens/month): 500 x $70 = $35,000 / month (Hosted)

Dedicated (reserved capacity) — ballparks (monthly committed GPU pool + infra):
- Small commit: 1 x A100-equivalent pool (supports ~80–120 qps depending on seq length): $18,000 / month committed
- Medium commit: 4 x A100-equivalent pool: $65,000 / month committed (better unit economics at scale)
- Effective per-1M-token cost depends on utilization. Example: with Medium commit and 500M tokens/month sustained, effective unit cost can be <$20 per 1M tokens.

Private / VPC (customer-managed networking + on-prem)
- One-time onboarding & integration: $30k–$80k (depending on on-prem vs VPC setup)
- Monthly infra + support premium: add 10–30% on top of Dedicated commit pricing
- KMS: we support AWS KMS customer-managed keys for Private & Dedicated; small per-request costs apply (pass-through).

Other costs:
- Network egress: depends on region; for US egress we typically model $0.05–$0.12 / GB.
- Logging & retention: S3 storage + audit log delivery; estimate ~$100–$1,000 / month depending on retention window and traffic.

Guidance:
- If you’re validating and not yet at predictable volume, start on Hosted for speed and move to Dedicated once you have sustained monthly volume (~200–300M tokens/month) or strict latency/throughput SLOs.
- If PHI + regulatory constraints require customer-managed networking, plan for Private/VPC early — it increases onboarding time but avoids later migrations.

Next steps (action items):
- I’ll loop Rishi + Laura to prepare a Dedicated commit quote for Small and Medium tiers (include unit economics at 50M / 200M / 500M tokens).
- If you confirm Scenario A vs B, we’ll schedule a follow-up to review the formal quote and discuss a POC timeline.
